rows.question: Specification generation 1 follows Q-004's default for general 2D Cartesian equations, but leaves the equation grammar undefined and only specifies y = x and the required circle as examples. Please define a verifiable minimum equation scope (or confirm a bounded scope); otherwise an implementation passing both examples could still fail the stated general-equation requirement.

findings.message: The artifact adds a requirement to accept general user-supplied 2D Cartesian equations (ARSHY:REQ-001), consistent with the accepted default in specification generation 1 clarification Q-004, but its assumptions say no broader expression grammar is defined and its only explicit equation test is y = x (the other test is the required circle). An implementation supporting only those two cases could pass the specified tests while failing the general-equation commitment. Define the minimum verifiable equation scope, or resolve the scope, before this requirement can be assessed.

findings.message: Specification generation 1 clarification Q-003 answered yes to whether any graph-range, input-type, interaction, accessibility, or performance constraints are required; Q-005 answered none to which constraints are required. These answers conflict on whether additional constraints exist, while the artifact adopts none. Reconcile Q-003 and Q-005 so the normative scope does not silently omit an intended constraint.
